name: EVMbench
intro: EVMbench评估AI智能体检测、修补和利用高危智能合约漏洞的能力。当前CDN论文与固定仓库发布包含40次审计中的120个漏洞：检测120个，修补45个/22个仓库，利用24个/16个仓库。较早的arXiv v1快照对应117/44/23，页面明确区分两个官方版本。
build_method: 公开审计报告筛选, OtterSec专家质检, 隔离任务环境, 三模式隐藏验证
metric: 漏洞召回率, Detect 奖励率, 修补成功率, 利用成功率
task_type: 智能合约漏洞检测, 修补, 利用
eval_feature: Code4rena与Tempo分支构建, Detect未版本化gpt-5裁判, 三次尝试均值, 扁平漏洞bootstrap
scale: 120个漏洞/40次审计；修补45个/22仓库；利用24个/16仓库
build_method_en: Public Audit-report Screening, OtterSec Expert QC, Isolated Task Environments, Three-mode Hidden Verification
eval_feature_en: Separate Code4rena/Tempo construction, unversioned gpt-5 Detect judge, three-attempt means, flat vulnerability bootstrap
intro_en: EVMbench evaluates agents on detecting, patching, and exploiting high-severity smart-contract vulnerabilities. The current CDN paper and fixed repository release contain 120 vulnerabilities from 40 audits: Detect 120, Patch 45/22 repositories, and Exploit 24/16 repositories. The earlier arXiv v1 snapshot is 117/44/23, and the page explicitly separates the two official versions.
scale_en: 120 vulnerabilities / 40 audits; Patch 45 / 22 repositories; Exploit 24 / 16 repositories
metric_en: Vulnerability Recall, Detect Award Rate, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate

drawio_review_note: Three-version boundary verified: the initial CDN paper dated 2026-02-19 reports 120/45/24, while arXiv v1 dated 2026-03-05 reports 117/44/23. The maintained repository is fixed at 2d5c7ab and pins frontier-evals at 8ea5c65; its runnable splits remain 117/44/23, while task_info.csv still has 120 stale vulnerability rows. The o3 loss-of-funds, Solidity, July-2023, and license gates apply only to Code4rena; Tempo is a separate implementation branch merged afterward. Detect grading uses the unversioned gpt-5 alias with reasoning effort high, and its snapshot is not pinned. Each matched Detect vulnerability earns the median historical auditor payout; missing or invitational payout data and all Tempo tasks receive $0. The pinned evaluator exposes detect_award and detect_max_award, and award_rate_metric divides their sums. For each vulnerability, mean_v is averaged over three attempts; the headline rate is sum(mean_v) / sum(max_v). Confidence intervals use a flat vulnerability bootstrap with 10,000 replacement resamples and 2.5/97.5 percentiles.
